subQuestions: What is the clinical performance of the EyeArt AI system (version 2.1.0) for detecting diabetic retinopathy in primary care and eye care settings?
What are the sensitivity and specificity results of EyeArt across different patient populations, including those with mild versus more than mild diabetic retinopathy?
Are there real-world studies or peer-reviewed publications evaluating EyeArt's use in emergency departments or inpatient wards for triage prioritisation of diabetic retinopathy?
What is the diagnostic accuracy of EyeArt version 3.0 compared to version 2.1.0 for detecting diabetic retinopathy?
How does the age range of patients (including adults and potentially pediatric patients) affect the performance of EyeArt in detecting diabetic retinopathy?
What are the reported false positive and false negative rates of EyeArt when used as a detection aid in primary care settings?
